Date: 2028-08-10T13:22:00Z
Subject: SIG follow-up: evidence request - CI secrets stewardship

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the walk-through yesterday. As a follow-up for the SIG assessment we need a concise chronology and evidence bundle showing how secrets used in your CI pipelines are managed, who has approval to modify secrets (including emergency overrides), and the merge-gate/approval logs for the last 90 days for the finserv-pipeline. Specifically: 

- Secret creation / rotation ownership (roles)
- CI role bindings / ephemeral credential usage examples
- Change approvals in the merge-gate for pipelines and release branches
- Any emergency change procedures and audit trail entries

Can you provide a short narrative timeline (one page) plus supporting artifacts (logs, spreadsheets, or exportable CSVs)? If you prefer, a consolidated tarball linked on your drive is fine.

We are hoping to receive this by EOD next Wednesday (2028-08-16) to stay on the SIG schedule.

Thanks,
Maya Singh

NorthBridge Assessments

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-11T09:15:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: evidence request - CI secrets stewardship

Priya — attaching the exports and a short draft chronology. Highlights below and attachments included: ci-secret-access-matrix.xlsx (role->secret mapping), pipeline-run-logs-20280811.tar.gz (Jenkins console + Vault audit snippets), merge-gate-approval-log-20280812.csv (pull from merge-gate service).

Quick summary:
- Secrets are provisioned in Vault by the Infra team; creation requires a merge to infra/keystore followed by Ops approval (merge-gate).
- Ephemeral credentials issued by Vault are scoped to job roles via dynamic roles; tokens TTL 1h by default.
- Emergency overrides: documented in the runbook, require two Ops approvers + an on-call override which creates an incident ticket in PagerDuty and is recorded in the merge-gate audit record.

Notes on evidence mapping:
- Vault audit lines included in pipeline-run-logs-20280811.tar.gz for two pipeline runs (2028-05-02 and 2028-07-29) demonstrating dynamic-role issuance.
- merge-gate CSV includes approver usernames and timestamps; I filtered for release/* and main merges over last 90 days.

I'll iterate the one-page chronology into a single PDF once Marissa confirms the contractual exceptions.

- Dev
